speaker: narrative
text: Sir William's voice falls away behind you. Across the floor, a man turns his head.

speaker: narrative
text: Mr Darcy has not yet spoken; he simply looks at you, measuring.

speaker: narrative
text: The Meryton rooms are full to the walls and bright as day.

speaker: arabella2
text: A bet against the room. Charlotte does love a sure thing.

speaker: arabella2
text: He claimed the set. I never said yes — and I never once said no.
tag: [quiet, pleased with herself, a smile in it]

speaker: arabella2
text: Hertfordshire's ceiling, Mr Darcy, is rather your floor.

speaker: darcy
text: Hertfordshire sets a modest ceiling, Miss Frost. I wonder if you find it so.

speaker: darcy
text: My sister is sixteen. She would sooner face a regiment than a room like this one.

speaker: darcy
text: The lady is engaged to me for this set, Carter.
tag: [low, firm, not to be argued with]

speaker: sir-william2
text: A dish! My dear Miss Frost, a dish does not answer back. That is precisely why I want you at the table.

speaker: sir-william2
text: Between ourselves, Miss Frost, I mean to put you before Mr Darcy before supper is served.

speaker: arabella-mind
text: A man who brings his own weather. I wonder who taught him.

speaker: arabella-mind
text: There. Now he is the only person in the room who has not seen you. Good.

speaker: lady
text: Ten thousand a year, and he has not asked anyone. Not even Miss Long.

speaker: officer
text: Quiet. The one by the door is listening.

speaker: carter
text: Miss Frost. The set is forming, and I find I cannot bear to see it form without you.
